body:
Added the extended `filename*` attribute as described on [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Content-Disposition#syntax).

Also it seems that Next.js automatically decodes values of request query. For the extended `filename*` attribute the value should be encoded, but I am not sure about the regular one:

> The parameters filename and filename* differ only in that filename* uses the encoding defined in [RFC 5987, section 3.2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5987#section-3.2). When both filename and filename* are present in a single header field value, filename* is preferred over filename when both are understood. It's recommended to include both for maximum compatibility, and you can convert filename* to filename by substituting non-ASCII characters with ASCII equivalents (such as converting é to e). You may want to avoid percent escape sequences in filename, because they are handled inconsistently across browsers. (Firefox and Chrome decode them, while Safari does not.)


Fixes: #259

author: bug-ops
body:
## Summary

Complete type system redesign using advanced Rust type-level programming:

- **Typestate Pattern**: Compile-time enforcement of state machine transitions
- **Sealed Traits**: Controlled extension points preventing external implementations
- **Associated Types**: Cleaner trait APIs with unique type relationships
- **Phantom Types**: Zero-cost type-safe markers

### Phase 1: Foundation
- Consolidated `Mode` enum (removed duplicate)
- Added sealed trait infrastructure for `SessionState`
- Created typestate markers: `Active`, `Completed`, `Abandoned`

### Phase 2: GameSession Typestate
- `GameSession<State>` generic over state markers
- `record_action()` consumes self, returns `SessionAfterAction` enum
- Methods split by state: `score()`/`feedback()` only on `Completed`
- `abandon()` returns `GameSession<Abandoned>`

### Phase 3: TypedScreen Pattern
- `TypedScreen` enum with required data per variant
- `TaskData` contains session (always exists)
- `ResultsData` contains feedback (always exists)
- Command key constants (no hardcoded strings)

### Phase 4: HelixSimulator Mode Typestate
- `HelixSimulator<M: EditorMode>` generic over mode
- `NormalMode`/`InsertMode` zero-sized markers
- `AnyModeSimulator` wrapper for runtime mode switching
- Fixed repeat insert mode bug

## Breaking Changes

- `record_action(&mut self)` → `record_action(self) -> SessionAfterAction`
- `get_feedback()` → `feedback()` (only on Completed/Abandoned)
- Removed: `state()`, `is_active()`, `is_completed()`
- Screen state moved from `UIState` to `TypedScreen`

## Benefits

```rust
// Before: Runtime crash possible
session.record_action("dd")?;
if session.is_completed() { ... }  // can fail
let feedback = session.get_feedback()?;  // can panic

// After: Compile-time safe
match session.record_action(CMD_DELETE_LINE)? {
    SessionAfterAction::Completed(s) => s.feedback()?,  // guaranteed valid
    SessionAfterAction::StillActive(s) => ...,
}
```

## Test plan

- [x] All 446 tests passing
- [x] Zero clippy warnings
- [x] Code formatted with `cargo +nightly fmt`
- [x] Compile-time type safety verified
- [x] Invalid states unrepresentable

body: # 🚀 Fix: Unassigned Tasks Assignment Bugs on Profile Page ## Description This PR fixes multiple bugs affecting the task assignment functionality on the Unassigned tab of user profile pages (`/profile/[memberId]`). **Problems fixed:** - Any user could assign tasks to others without permission (security issue) - Clickable area on assignment button was too small - No data synchronization after assignment (required page refresh) - Modal didn't close immediately after loading completed - No toast notification feedback for success/error - Menu showed static "Assign Task" instead of dynamic "Assign/Unassign Task to/from Me" - No loading state on menu button during assignment ## What Was Changed ### Major Changes - Added `useCanSeeActivityScreen()` hook in `TaskCard` to restrict assignment button visibility to managers and profile owners only - Fixed cache invalidation in `useTaskFilterCache` by counting `totalMembers` across ALL tasks (not just first 10) - Added direct Jotai store update in `updateTaskMutation.onSuccess` for immediate UI refresh without page reload - Implemented dynamic menu label: checks if logged-in user is in `task.members` to show "Assign Task to Me" or "Unassign Task from Me" - Added `isAssigning` state with loading spinner on the "..." vertical menu button during assignment action ### Minor Changes - Made entire circular assignment button clickable (moved `onClick` from icon to parent container) - Modal now closes immediately after successful API response - Added success toast with task title and member names (shows "Added: X, Y" / "Removed: Z") - Added error toast with descriptive message (dev mode shows error details) - Added guard clause in `handleAssignment` to prevent infinite loading if `memberInfo` is undefined - Added custom React.memo comparator on `UsersTaskAssigned` to detect member changes - Added 7 new translation keys in 13 languages (ar, bg, de, en, es, fr, he, it, nl, pl, pt, ru, zh) ## How to Test This PR 1. Run `yarn web:dev` 2. Open browser at `http://localhost:3030` 3. Navigate to `/profile/[memberId]` → click on "Unassigned" tab 4. Test the following scenarios: - Click "..." on a task → verify label shows "Assign Task to Me" or "Unassign Task from Me" based on your assignment state - Click "Assign Task to Me" → verify spinner appears on "..." button, then success toast appears - Click "..." again → verify label has toggled to "Unassign Task from Me" - Click the circular assignment button (dashed border) → verify entire area is clickable, not just center icon - Select members in modal and click "Confirm" → verify modal closes immediately, toast shows with member names, UI updates instantly without page refresh ## Screenshots ### Previous screenshots https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a409c54c-0cd8-4953-bd8b-fb0625f98f31 ### Current screenshots https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d84f4249-b143-47f7-aa8d-672ba2af3cfb ## Related Issues - Closes [ETP-187-[Bug]-[Web] Clickable Area Too Small on Assignment Button](https://evertech.atlassian.net/browse/ETP-187) - Closes [ETP-188-[Web]-[Bug] No Data Synchronization After Task Assignment](https://evertech.atlassian.net/browse/ETP-188) - Closes [ETP-191-[Web]-[Bug] Assign Task Menu Should Say Assign Task to Me + Task Incorrectly Disappears](https://evertech.atlassian.net/browse/ETP-191) - Closes [ETP-192-[Task] Dynamic Assign/Unassign Label + Loading State on Menu Button](https://evertech.atlassian.net/browse/ETP-192) ## Type of Change - [x] Bug fix (fixes a problem) - [x] New feature (adds functionality) - [ ] Breaking change (requires changes elsewhere) - [ ] Documentation update ## ✅ Checklist - [x] My code follows the project coding style - [x] I reviewed my own code and added comments where needed - [x] I tested my changes locally - [x] I updated or created related documentation if needed - [x] No new warnings or errors are introduced ## Notes for the Reviewer - TypeScript compilation, ESLint, and production build all pass - Cache invalidation now counts members across ALL tasks to ensure any assignment change triggers UI update - Added guard clause in `handleAssignment` to prevent infinite loading state if `memberInfo` is undefined - Other changes related to this PR had been made in https://github.com/ever-co/ever-teams/pull/4181 by mistake on those commits: - @NdekoCode [feat(web): conditionally render task assignee image based on activity…](https://github.com/ever-co/ever-teams/pull/4181/commits/c2882ac82f8ee730c69729687c70b059eaa02471) [c2882ac](https://github.com/ever-co/ever-teams/pull/4181/commits/c2882ac82f8ee730c69729687c70b059eaa02471) - author: archers007
body:
This pull request introduces a major refactor of user authentication and data storage, shifting user management from file-based storage to a SQLite database using the `better-sqlite3` library. It also adds new scripts for seeding the database and exposes an endpoint to list all users. These changes improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability of user data.

**Database integration and user management:**

* Added a new `utils/database.js` module that manages user data using SQLite (`better-sqlite3`), including methods for adding, retrieving, and listing users.
* Refactored `utils/auth.js` (renamed from `auth.js`) to use the new database-backed `Users` API for all user operations instead of file-based storage. This includes user creation, authentication, and retrieval by ID. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-8757d61b21af5b38b5adb709a03845a2fbc99ddadce574843abfb21ce60d87d7L1-R2) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-8757d61b21af5b38b5adb709a03845a2fbc99ddadce574843abfb21ce60d87d7L33-R17) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-8757d61b21af5b38b5adb709a03845a2fbc99ddadce574843abfb21ce60d87d7L52-R33) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-8757d61b21af5b38b5adb709a03845a2fbc99ddadce574843abfb21ce60d87d7L64-R49) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-8757d61b21af5b38b5adb709a03845a2fbc99ddadce574843abfb21ce60d87d7L85-R64) [[6]](diffhunk://#diff-8757d61b21af5b38b5adb709a03845a2fbc99ddadce574843abfb21ce60d87d7L95)

**Server and API updates:**

* Updated `server.js` to import the new database and user management modules, and added a new `/users` endpoint to return all users from the database. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fL4-R7) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-a4c65ede64197e1a112899a68bf994485b889c4b143198bac4af53425b38406fL133-R144)

**Package and script changes:**

* Updated `package.json` to add new dependencies (`better-sqlite3`, `path`), and added scripts for seeding the database (`seed`, `seed:fresh`) and running the seed script after install (`postinstall`).

**Minor improvements:**

* Changed the dashboard route from `/dashboard.html` to `/dashboard` for consistency.
* Reformatted the `keywords` array in `package.json` for readability.

author: jpoley
body:
## Summary

Implements task-174: ADR Requirement Gate with Transition Validation.

This PR adds Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) as required output artifacts from `/jpspec:plan` workflow with complete structural validation and auto-increment numbering support.

### Features Implemented

✅ **AC1: ADR Template** - Created `templates/adr-template.md` following Nygard format  
✅ **AC2: /jpspec:plan Output** - ADRs output to `./docs/adr/ADR-{NNN}-{slug}.md`  
✅ **AC3: ADR Existence Check** - Validation before transition to "Planned" state  
✅ **AC4: Structural Validation** - All required sections must be present  
✅ **AC5: NONE Validation** - Default validation mode (no gate)  
✅ **AC6: KEYWORD Validation** - Support for `KEYWORD["<string>"]` mode  
✅ **AC7: PULL_REQUEST Validation** - Support for PR-gated transitions  
✅ **AC8: Multiple ADRs** - Support for ADR-001, ADR-002, etc.  
✅ **AC9: Auto-increment Numbering** - Scans existing ADRs, finds max, adds 1  

### Required ADR Sections (Nygard Format)

- **Status**: Proposed | Accepted | Deprecated | Superseded
- **Context**: Forces at play (technological, political, social)
- **Decision**: Response to forces in active voice
- **Consequences**: Positive and negative impacts
- **Alternatives Considered**: Options evaluated and rejected

### Implementation Details

**Files Added:**
- `templates/adr-template.md` - Nygard format template with placeholders
- `src/specify_cli/workflow/artifact_validators.py` - ADRValidator class
- `src/specify_cli/workflow/transition.py` - Transition schema (from task-172)
- `tests/test_adr_validator.py` - Comprehensive test suite

**Key Functions:**
- `ADRValidator.validate()` - Validates ADR structure and required sections
- `get_next_adr_number()` - Auto-increment numbering by scanning existing ADRs
- `find_existing_adrs()` - Discovery and listing of ADR files

**Validation Modes:**
- `NONE` - No gate, transition proceeds automatically
- `KEYWORD["APPROVED"]` - User must type exact keyword
- `PULL_REQUEST` - Blocked until PR merged

### Test Coverage

**23 tests, all passing:**
- `get_next_adr_number`: 6 tests (empty dir, single ADR, multiple, gaps, non-ADR files)
- `find_existing_adrs`: 6 tests (discovery, sorting, filtering)
- `ADRValidator`: 11 tests (valid/invalid ADRs, sections, status, filenames)
- Integration: 2 tests (sequence creation, bulk validation)

```
============================= 23 passed in 0.10s ==============================
```

### Pattern Usage

ADR files follow the pattern: `ADR-{NNN}-{slug}.md`

Examples:
- `ADR-001-database-choice.md`
- `ADR-002-api-framework.md`
- `ADR-003-deployment-strategy.md`

Numbering automatically increments from the highest existing number.

## Test Plan

- [x] All 23 tests pass
- [x] ADR template validates correctly
- [x] Auto-increment numbering works with gaps
- [x] Validator detects missing required sections

author: hkati
body:
## Summary

This PR updates the overlay validation helper so that it matches the
current repo layout while still supporting the intended pack-level
paths.

- file: `scripts/validate_overlays.py`

## Motivation

Codex reported that the validator was only looking for:

- `schemas/g_field_v0.schema.json`
- `PULSE_safe_pack_v0/artifacts/g_field_v0.json`

while in this repo the existing files currently live under:

- `schemas/schemas/g_field_v0.schema.json`
- `./g_field_v0.json` at the repo root.

As a result, the validator always logged
`[INFO] g_field_v0: data file not found, skipping.`
and never actually validated the overlay.

## Implementation details

- Introduce `OverlaySpec` with:
  - `schema_candidates: List[Path]`
  - `data_candidates: List[Path]`
- For each overlay (`g_field_v0`, `g_field_stability_v0`,
  `g_epf_overlay_v0`, `gpt_external_detection_v0`) look for:
  - schemas:
    - `schemas/<name>.schema.json`
    - `schemas/schemas/<name>.schema.json`
  - data:
    - `PULSE_safe_pack_v0/artifacts/<name>.json`
    - `./<name>.json`
- Use the first existing schema and data paths for validation.
- If no data file is found under any candidate paths, log INFO and skip
  in shadow mode instead of failing.

This keeps the validator CI-neutral but ensures that existing overlays
are actually checked against their schemas.

## Next steps

- In a follow-up change, adjust the
  `.github/workflows/overlay_schema_validation_shadow.yml` path filters
  so that it consistently triggers on both root-level overlays and
  pack-level artefacts.

author: umwelt
body:
## Summary

Successfully migrated zhtp crate to P1-7 seed-anchored identity architecture, fixing all 60 compilation errors.

**Result: 60 errors → 0 errors (100% fixed) ✅**

## Changes Made

### 1. ZhtpIdentity Constructor Migration (10+ instances)
- Replaced all `ZhtpIdentity::new()` calls with `new_unified()`
- Files: storage/mod.rs, web4/content.rs, web4/domains.rs, shared_dht.rs, did_startup.rs

### 2. Identity System Initialization (2 errors)
- Fixed `initialize_identity_system_with_identities` → use base `initialize_identity_system()` + `add_identity()`
- File: runtime/components/identity.rs

### 3. PrivateKey Field Access (2 errors)
- Fixed `private_key.dilithium_pk` → use `public_key.dilithium_pk`
- File: runtime/did_startup.rs

### 4. PublicKey API Updates (7 errors)
- `len()` → `size()`
- Added `as_bytes()` for hex encoding and signature verification
- Files: web4/domains.rs, identity/mod.rs, crypto/mod.rs, blockchain_sync.rs, identity_api.rs

### 5. Signing Method Migration (3 errors)
- Replaced obsolete `sign_message_for_identity` with direct `lib_crypto::sign_message`
- Get private key from `identity.private_key` field
- Create `KeyPair` and sign using `lib_crypto`
- Files: identity/mod.rs, crypto/mod.rs, web4/domains.rs

### 6. Getter Method Updates (2 errors)
- `get_dilithium_public_key` → access `identity.public_key.dilithium_pk` directly
- `get_private_data` → access `identity.private_key` field directly
- Files: web4/domains.rs, marketplace/mod.rs

### 7. Struct Initialization Updates (2 errors)
- Replaced manual `ZhtpIdentity { ... }` construction with `new_unified()`
- Files: runtime/mod.rs, dht/mod.rs

### 8. Obsolete API Stubs (2 errors)
- Stubbed removed methods: `sync_wallet_balances`, `create_payment_transaction`
- Commented unreachable transaction building code with TODO for future reimplementation
- File: runtime/mod.rs

### 9. Type Mismatch Fixes (8 errors)
- Fixed PublicKey wrapping - use `.clone()` not `PublicKey::new()`
- Fixed PublicKey to bytes - use `.as_bytes()` for verification
- Fixed identity function returns - now return IDs not full identities
- Fixed seed array size - 64 bytes not 32 for `new_unified()`
- Files: bootstrap_service.rs, protocols.rs, unified_server.rs, identity_api.rs, dht/mod.rs

## Testing

```bash
cargo build --package zhtp
# Result: 0 errors ✅
```

## Migration Notes

### P1-7 Architecture Key Changes:
- **Seed-anchored identity**: DIDs derived deterministically from seed, not PQC keypairs
- **WalletManager**: Replaced `IdentityWallets`, uses `WalletType` enum
- **new_unified()**: Simplified constructor (5 args vs 8+ in old new())
- **Private keys**: Stored in `identity.private_key` field, not separate manager
- **Signing**: Direct `lib_crypto::sign_message()` with `KeyPair`, not through IdentityManager

### Breaking Changes:
- `create_user_identity_with_wallet()` now returns `(IdentityId, WalletId, String)` not full identities
- `create_node_device_identity()` now returns `IdentityId` not full identity
- Several IdentityManager methods removed: `sign_message_for_identity`, `get_dilithium_public_key`, `get_private_data`, `sync_wallet_balances`, `create_payment_transaction`

## Next Steps

- [ ] Review transaction building code that was stubbed out
- [ ] Reimplement payment transaction creation using new WalletManager API
- [ ] Update any integration tests that depend on old identity creation functions

body:
Adds dynamic DNS support via DuckDNS with automatic IP updates every 5 minutes using a systemd timer.

## Changes

- **`scripts/update-duckdns.sh`** - Update script using DuckDNS API, reads `DUCKDNS_TOKEN` and `DUCKDNS_DOMAIN` from environment
- **`infrastructure/systemd/duckdns-update.service`** - Oneshot service loading env from `/etc/duckdns/duckdns.env`
- **`infrastructure/systemd/duckdns-update.timer`** - Timer triggering every 5 minutes (1 min after boot)
- **`docs/DUCKDNS.md`** - Setup guide covering required GitHub secrets, VM installation, and troubleshooting

## Usage

```bash
# VM setup
sudo mkdir -p /etc/duckdns && sudo chmod 600 /etc/duckdns
echo "DUCKDNS_TOKEN=<token>" | sudo tee /etc/duckdns/duckdns.env
echo "DUCKDNS_DOMAIN=<subdomain>" | sudo tee -a /etc/duckdns/duckdns.env

# Enable timer
sudo systemctl enable --now duckdns-update.timer
```

body:
## Summary

Adds frontend estimated offer calculations for the seller submission form, showing real-time quotes based on Discogs market data and the buyer pricing policy.

## Changes

**Backend:**
- Updated release search endpoint to include latest Discogs market data (statLow, statMedian, statHigh)

**Frontend:**
- Calculate estimated offers: `lowest_discogs_price × 55% × condition_adjustment`
- Shows in search results: "Estimate: \$23.50 → Add to List"
- Condition multipliers: M=115%, NM=100%, VG+=80%, VG=65%, VG-=50%, G=30%
- Weighted by buyer policy: 70% media condition + 30% sleeve condition
- Quote updates in submission list based on selected conditions
- Shows "Needs Review" for items without market data

## Calculation Formula

```
base_offer = lowest_discogs_price × 55% (buyer percentage)
condition_adjustment = (media_multiplier × 0.7) + (sleeve_multiplier × 0.3)
estimated_offer = base_offer × condition_adjustment
```

## Files Modified

- `backend/src/services/releaseService.js` - Include marketData in search results
- `backend/src/public/js/submit.js` - Calculate and display estimated quotes

body:
Client exits uncleanly after ~1 hour when AWS token expires mid-stream. The background token refresher updates credentials, but active transcription streams don't recover from expiration errors.

## Changes

- **Token expiration detection**: New `isTokenExpiredError()` matches specific AWS error patterns (`expiredtokenexception`, `security token expired`, etc.) without false positives on unrelated "expired" messages

- **Retry loop in `listenAndTranscribe()`**: On token expiration, requests fresh credentials from server and restarts transcription stream. Max 3 retries with appropriate delays.

- **Error propagation**: `startTranscribeStream()` now wraps token errors in `TokenExpiredError` from both event stream reader and audio sender goroutines

```go
// Detection patterns
expiredPatterns := []string{
    "expiredtokenexception",
    "the security token included in the request is expired",
    "token has expired",
    "security token expired", 
    "credentials have expired",
}
```

- Existing lint error (redundant newline in `fmt.Println`)
